title: HDPE good-output boundary: a 100 t lot with 5 t downgraded (first-pass quality 95 %), and a rework round trip that recovers the 5 t without 105 t of net product
spec_ref: SME E3 (good-output boundary and product disposition), V2 (downgrade / rework valuation), EXPERT_REVIEW Q14

inputs.shift: 8 h per period, one product slice, sustained and planning rate 12.5 t/h, target 100 t
inputs.period1: meter gross 100 t, rejects not measured; lot L-100 produced 00:00-08:00 (lab release 10:00), approved disposition 5 t downgrade
inputs.period2: meter gross 105 t = 100 t fresh + 5 t of L-100 reprocessed through the same boundary (recovery movement, remeasured)
inputs.prices: intended $1,000/t, downgrade sold at $800/t (price difference $200/t), rework cost $60/t; no impact code, no default disposition
